rubric.note: Subjective internal editorial ratings with evidence; not an automatic humour metric or an independent live review.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: How did you get into the members' lounge without showing your pass?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They know me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Right. I'll learn every doorman's birthday. Systematically.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I can introduce you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, thank you. I'd like to develop spontaneous rapport properly.

card.title: Effortless Insider
card.instruction: Treat someone’s effortless movement through systems and customs as both impressive and threatening, then prove you can master every rule without help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You knew which fork to use without looking. I've studied the whole table plan.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I copied the person beside me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I could have copied. I chose independent mastery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're serving soup now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then give me a moment to revise my fork research.

card.title: Effortless Insider
card.instruction: Treat someone’s effortless movement through systems and customs as both impressive and threatening, then prove you can master every rule without help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The complaint desk is here to listen. That's what my old badge says.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There's no one at the desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Listening takes many forms.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The sign says it's closed permanently.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then perhaps they're giving our concerns a very long silence.

card.title: When I Believed in the Rules
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself who once trusted the institution, tradition, or process. Use its old language even as your confidence slips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The club always looks after its own. I've paid dues for thirty years.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They've rented your locker to someone else.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: There must be a respectful explanation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The new member paid more.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ah. They've updated the meaning of 'its own.'

card.title: When I Believed in the Rules
card.instruction: Perform the version of yourself who once trusted the institution, tradition, or process. Use its old language even as your confidence slips.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: On this picnic form, does 'bringing food' include bringing the plates?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Just tick whatever seems closest.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is there a box confirming that you authorised approximation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's a picnic.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then why have they left the sandwich category so open?

card.title: There Must Be a Correct Form
card.instruction: Treat every unclear instruction as a test you may be failing. Seek safety through stricter compliance, documentation, and permission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: May I ask a question during the induction?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Questions are encouraged.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Should I register mine first?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: No. Just ask.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is asking permission counted against the question allowance?

card.title: There Must Be a Correct Form
card.instruction: Treat every unclear instruction as a test you may be failing. Seek safety through stricter compliance, documentation, and permission.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've written a checklist so you can safely make tea while I'm out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've made tea for forty years.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You can initial the experience section.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just have water?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cold or room temperature? I need the correct appendix.

card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before you borrow my bicycle, let's rehearse what to do if you wobble.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll put my foot down.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. Which foot?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Whichever side I'm falling toward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I hadn't included improvisation. We'll need another rehearsal.

card.title: For Everyone’s Protection
card.instruction: Protect people by creating procedures for them. Turn concern into checklists, permissions, required steps, and increasingly narrow exceptions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Have I bowed deeply enough to join the choir, or is that the rehearsal bow?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We don't bow until the concert.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Good. I'll keep this one in reserve.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You can stand up now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. I didn't want to be the first person to abandon tradition.

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I memorised the club toast, including the footnotes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There aren't any footnotes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I researched the founding members' preferred pauses.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We usually just say 'cheers.'

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Would that be the formal or familiar cheers?

card.title: Properly Initiated
card.instruction: Treat correct participation in the ritual as proof you deserve to belong. Watch for cues, copy the form, and overcommit to every step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Notice the green stamp on your permit. Very few people know why it's green.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Thanks for getting it approved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Approval is easy. The colour history is fascinating.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I start building?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: After you appreciate why it isn't blue.

card.title: Ask Me About the Process
card.instruction: Create opportunities to display your knowledge of obscure rules, customs, and procedures. Correct small details before anyone can praise the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I used the proper salutation on your complaint letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Wonderful. They fixed the leak.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But did they mention the salutation?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They sent a plumber.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll ask him whether he noticed the regional variation.

card.title: Ask Me About the Process
card.instruction: Create opportunities to display your knowledge of obscure rules, customs, and procedures. Correct small details before anyone can praise the outcome.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Set an empty bowl for Great-Uncle Arthur before we serve dinner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Arthur is here this year.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then he'll finally get to see his bowl.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can we put soup in it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Not after forty years of keeping it empty for him.

card.title: Tradition Outranks Explanation
card.instruction: Treat inherited customs as meaningful because they have been repeated. Preserve each step and resist every request to explain why it still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We must walk around the new boat three times before launching it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Who started that?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My grandfather.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Did he explain why?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: He completed all three circuits. That was explanation enough.

card.title: Tradition Outranks Explanation
card.instruction: Treat inherited customs as meaningful because they have been repeated. Preserve each step and resist every request to explain why it still matters.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The visitor book is missing your middle initial. Stop the tour.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll add it now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We need a witness for amendments.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're watching me write.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And who will confirm I was watching correctly?

card.title: One Missing Step
card.instruction: Treat the smallest skipped step as the beginning of systemic collapse. Escalate safeguards, documentation, and oversight before allowing anything to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You skipped item six on the kettle checklist.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Item six says check that the lid is closed. It's closed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: But we can't prove you checked it before item seven.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll start again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First we need a procedure for interrupted kettle procedures.

card.title: One Missing Step
card.instruction: Treat the smallest skipped step as the beginning of systemic collapse. Escalate safeguards, documentation, and oversight before allowing anything to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We've been in this queue two hours. Imagine how thoroughly they're checking things.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The counter is empty.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. No rushed decisions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The office closed an hour ago.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we're protected from after-hours processing too.

card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My application has gone to a third committee. Such a reassuring system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The first two lost it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And yet a third committee stands ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They want you to apply again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. This time three committees know what to look for.

card.title: The System Works
card.instruction: Celebrate every queue, delay, review, and formal approval as proof that a dependable system is protecting everyone from chaos.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: If the moon audits our village tonight, who signs for the findings?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The oldest owl.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Is the owl available before the post office closes?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It only works after dark.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then we'd better budget for a late filing fee.

card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: At the dragon's naming ceremony, where do we put the fire extinguishers?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The dragon eats anyone who brings one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Fine. Who handles the insurance exemption?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody insures dragons.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then the deposit needs to cover the hall.

card.title: Fine, What’s the Process?
card.instruction: Accept any strange custom or institution as real, then focus on deadlines, permissions, responsibilities, and what happens when someone misses a step.

transfer.action: I hide my instruction sheet and handle {prop} with rehearsed polish.
transfer.opening: Some of us actually learn all the formalities. {request}
transfer.response: Watch me get through without an introduction. {counter}
transfer.challenge: You could accept a little help.
transfer.closing: I'd prefer to arrive in a way nobody can call an escort.

transfer.action: I polish my old institutional badge beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I used to mean every word of the motto. {request}
transfer.response: Show me where the old promise still holds. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then I need to know which word on the badge stopped being true.

transfer.action: I put a permission-to-ask form beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: I don't want to fail before I've started. {request}
transfer.response: Show me the exact box I'm allowed to tick. {counter}
transfer.closing: Which form records that you authorized my judgement?

transfer.action: I lay a safety checklist beside {prop}.
transfer.response: A witness line prevents unfortunate uncertainty. {counter}
transfer.closing: Precisely when people underestimate the need for a checklist.

transfer.action: I repeat the ceremonial bow over {prop}, twice as deeply.
transfer.opening: Was that enough to count me in? {request}
transfer.response: I can perform the full version if this one didn't count. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then tell me which step made it happen so I can trust it.

transfer.action: I produce the obscure appendix beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Most people never notice subsection four. {request}
transfer.response: You'll enjoy what the third stamp means. {counter}
transfer.closing: Then this process is about to lose its most elegant explanation.

transfer.action: I carry {prop} once around the table with solemn care.
transfer.opening: We do it because it was done before us. {request}
transfer.response: The explanation isn't part of the tradition. {counter}
transfer.closing: There is a beautifully established route around the table. Follow it.

transfer.action: I stop the paperwork around {prop} over one missing initial.
transfer.opening: One missing letter is how systems fail. {request}
transfer.response: We nearly missed the missed step. {counter}
transfer.closing: Better delayed correctly than hurried into an unchecked check.

transfer.action: I smile at the long queue beside {prop}.
transfer.opening: Look how carefully everyone is being protected. {request}
transfer.response: Another review is a safeguard we hadn't appreciated. {counter}
transfer.closing: An impressively large amount of caution is getting done.

transfer.action: I put the moon-audit ritual beside the timetable for {prop}.
transfer.opening: Fine, an annual moon audit. Who unlocks the room? {request}
transfer.response: The moon can be mysterious; the booking shouldn't be. {counter}
transfer.closing: I'm making sure its spirit has somewhere to park on Tuesday.
